thread:
morgan: quick flag — found a case where cross-tenant service-account keys show org/project metadata in the Console. may leak org mapping when keys are proxied.
alina: gah. example response?
morgan: pasted response in thread: ```{\n  \"key_id\": \"k-01ab\",\n  \"owner_org\": \"org-99\",\n  \"project\": \"billing-prod\",\n  \"created_by\": \"svc-invoicer\"\n}```
jia: is that coming from the auth service or from the proxy's enrichment step? leo, do you know?
leo: looks like the auth service attaches owner_org/project for internal attribution. proxy doesn't strip it when returning key details to the Console.
alina: console shows those fields on the key detail page right now? that's the concern — exposing mapping for cross-tenant keys.
morgan: yeah — it's on the UI for keys fetched by org admins and by a few support roles. We need to decide visibility policy for keys that are 'cross-tenant' (i.e., created by a SA in org A but used/impersonated by org B).
nate: thinking aloud: default principle should be least-privilege info exposure. If a key is used cross-tenant, Console should not show owner org unless the viewer is in that owner org or has explicit audit permission.
jia: +1. But we also need auditability for infra teams. Maybe add a gated flag: show_owner_org: true only for viewer roles with security/audit entitlement.
leo: how would we implement quickly? Two options: 1) strip fields at the proxy -> Console gets redacted data; 2) Console calls a protected admin-only endpoint for owner resolution. Option 1 is simpler for now.
alina: Option 1 could break internal tooling that expects owner fields. Are there many callers? deploy-bot: deploy-bot: notify: recent deploy to auth-service returned owner_org for 4% of key lookups (telemetry: key_owner_field_present=true)
morgan: telemetry: we saw 4% too. most are infra/service flows.
jia: If we do proxy-level redaction, we should add an audit log for requests that included owner resolution so SRE can still investigate.
leo: agree. Proposed short-term plan:
- proxy: redact owner_org/project for cross-tenant responses (flag redacted_owner=true in the response metadata sent to Console)
- auth-service: emit an internal-only audit event when owner resolution happens (include request id)
- Console: show a blurred "Owner: redacted" with a tooltip pointing to request audit or contact.
nate: long-term: add RBAC entitlements so certain roles can view full mapping via an audited path. Also add a Console feature flag for rollout.
alina: UX nit: "redacted" might freak product; maybe show "Restricted — contact security" copy.
morgan: also need quota routing consideration: routing policies currently attribute usage by project if owner_project present. If we strip project, billing attribution may change.
jia: good catch. routing/quotas rely on owner_project for cost attribution. We must ensure usage attribution remains accurate for billing even if Console is redacted.
leo: two separate concerns: telemetry/billing should still record owner_project internally (no change to billing pipelines); only the Console response should be redacted. So redaction is presentation-only.
alina: confirm we won't accidentally affect 3rd-party integrations that call the Keys API directly. We should add a response header X-Owner-Redacted: true when redaction occurs.
morgan: action items agreed:
- leo: implement proxy redaction + X-Owner-Redacted header. (ETA: 3d)
- jia: add auth-service audit event for owner resolution, wire to internal audit stream. (ETA: 5d)
- nate: add Console copy + feature flag + blurred UI state. (ETA: 4d)
- alina: draft privacy/security blurb and run by legal. (ETA: 2d)
- morgan: validate routing/quotas unaffected and add telemetry to verify billing attribution unchanged. (ETA: 3d)
alina: thumbs: let's also add a canary rollout in the Console for 10% of orgs first.
leo: will wire that into the feature flag.
morgan: thanks — i'll open the PRs and tag the infra oncall. anyone object to rolling this to canary tomorrow?
jia: no objections.
nate: no objections.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled feature-flag canary rollout for Console UI at 10% at 2025-02-05T02:00Z :rocket:
morgan: closing loop: i'll post PR links here once open.
alina: thanks all :thumbsup:
